paper_title: An FPTAS of Minimizing Total Weighted Completion Time on Single Machine with Position Constraint
statement: It remains open whether this problem is NP-hard or not. It will also be interesting to study the multiple position constraints, i.e. two or more jobs have fixed positions. In this setting, our dynamic programming algorithm could be easily generalized and the rounding technique will not change too much while it is difficult to design the FPTAS algorithm to avoid exponential number of recursions.
